{"content":"# OpenCode v2 Findings (M0) — DRAF, dilengkapi setelah capture selesai

Uji terhadap **OpenCode v2.0.16** (`opencode --version` + `GET /api/info` → `{"version":"2.0.16"}`),
klien `@opencode/client` **2.0.16** (pin eksak), model `openagentic/muse-spark-1.3-free`.
OpenAPI: `docs/fixtures/openapi.v2.json` (118 paths, 282 schemas, diunduh 2026-10-11 dari
`https://opencode.ai/v2/openapi.json`).

> Catatan: stream event bersifat GLOBAL (semua sesi + semua lokasi). 209/237 event pada
> fixture `00` berasal dari sesi lain. Bridge WAJIB memfilter berdasarkan
> `data.sessionID` / `location.directory`.

## 1. Bentuk event (wire)

- Envelope SSE: `{ event: "<type>", data: "<V2Event JSON string>" }`; setelah parse klien:
  `{ id: "evt_*", created, type, location?: {directory}, data, durable?: {aggregateID, seq, version}, metadata? }`.
- Daftar tipe nyata berasal dari tipe TS klien (bukan openapi). Contoh teramati:
  `server.connected`, `session.created`, `session.instructions.updated`,
  `session.inbox.enqueued/delivered`, `session.execution.started/succeeded/failed/interrupted`,
  `session.step.started/streamed/ended/failed`, `session.text.started/delta/ended`,
  `session.reasoning.*`, `session.tool.input.started/delta/ended`, `session.tool.called`,
  `session.tool.progress/success/failed`, `session.retry.scheduled`, `session.usage.updated`,
